title: share_offer body
description: A key holder's Obi gives the receiver's owner a share of a company-paid API account (protocol.md 5.14): jobs on it run on the key holder's Mac, and the key never leaves it. Starts an exchange that lasts as long as the share.

account.description: The account's name as its key holder calls it.

share.description: The share of the account's monthly budget, in percent.

limit_cents.description: That share in money this period: the most the receiver's owner's jobs may cost on it.
